issue_request: The Applied FHIR-core issue, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6, asked the Datatypes:Coding page to clarify that Coding.system should be populated whenever the system is known and that implicit context only helps when the system is otherwise not known.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps datatypes to the active datatype page, so source/datatypes.html is in build scope for Coding narrative. The cited Zulip thread and FHIR-I 2024-12-16 minutes both support the same clarification. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches did not identify a tightly related FHIR-core issue requiring a separate decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because source/datatypes.html already contains the approved wording at lines 714-719, and the Jira-tagged implementation commit is in current history. The published commit is an empty audit commit documenting that no further source change is needed.
